headline: META 🧩 STILL 🛑 RUNNING 💰 ADS 📣 Pushing 🧒 CHILD 🍑 ABUSE 📉 Material 🖼️ in INDIA 🇮🇳
text:
META 🧱 is straight COOKED 🍳 for KEEPING 🛠️ those 332 🧾 CSAM 📸 ads 📢 running 🏃‍♂️ on FACEBOOK 📘 and INSTAGRAM 📷 over the past TEN 🕒 MONTHS 🌙 according to the TECH 🖥️ TRANSPARENCY 🕵️ PROJECT 📊 report 📰 that DROPPED 📥 this week 🗓️ with a chunky 274 📈 of them hitting HARD 💥 in AUGUST ☀️ alone while the MAJORITY 👥 targeted INDIA 🇮🇳 and other spots 🌍 like the US 🦅 UK 🇬🇧 EU 🇪🇺 and AUSTRALIA 🐨!! The TTP sleuths 🕵️‍♂️ spotted 📍 real kid 🧒 photos including one from a EUROPEAN 👑 royal family 👨‍👩‍👧 that got AI 🤖 TWEAKED 🌀 into graphic 🍆 sexual acts 🎥 with voiceovers 🗣️ straight up advertising NUDIFY 🩲 apps that promise NO 🚫 RESTRICTIONS 🔓 and the ads kept SLIPPING 🧴 through even AFTER 🕒 the company was TIPPED 🔔 off by the researchers themselves!!

INDIAN 🇮🇳 GOVERNMENT 🏛️ had ORDERED 📜 META 🧱 just TWO 🕒 MONTHS 🌙 ago to NUKE ☢️ every last ad and post promoting CHILD 🧒 SEXUAL 🍑 ABUSE 📉 material after that BBC 📺 EYE 👁️ bombshell that caught Instagram 📷 serving PAID 💵 CSAM promos left and right but guess what the 84 🇮🇳 ads that ran there included 78 📆 that dropped AFTER 🕒 the order and the meeting 🤝 with senior META 🧱 officials making this whole situation look like a total CLAPBACK 💥 failure while agencies like the NATIONAL 🏛️ COMMISSION 🛡️ for PROTECTION 🛡️ of CHILD 🧒 RIGHTS ⚖️ and HUMAN 🧍 RIGHTS 🛡️ COMMISSION are now EXAMINING 🔎 the mess!! Bhuwan Ribhu 🧔 from JUST 🧾 RIGHTS 🛡️ for CHILDREN 👦 filed a petition 📜 in the SUPREME 🏛️ COURT ⚖️ citing the BBC findings and demanding mandatory REPORTING 📋 plus identification of everyone pushing this filth because social media giants are FLAT 🫥 OUT ignoring Indian laws that require them to SNITCH 🕵️ to local law enforcement instead of just dumping everything on the US based NCMEC 📍!!

TTP report 📊 laid out how almost EVERY 📋 one of those 332 🧾 ads started with an innocent kid 🧒 pic that gets AI 🤖 ANIMATED 🌀 mid video 🎞️ into performing graphic 🍆 sex acts with one INDIA 🇮🇳 example showing a PRETEEN 👧 girl getting manipulated while a voiceover 🗣️ brags THERE ARE NO 🚫 RESTRICTIONS 🔓 all characters are REAL 🧍 people and this is the AI 🤖 that MEN 👨 actually use which was BLASTED 📣 by more than FIFTY 5️⃣0️⃣ different handles 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 across a FORTNIGHT 🗓️ in AUGUST ☀️ directing thirsty users straight to mostly CHINESE 🇨🇳 developed image and video generation apps that basically scream USE 🛠️ US for making your own CSAM 📉!! When TTP tried reporting 55 📊 of the Indian ads through META 🧱 own system they got back replies like WE TOOK A LOOK 👀 and this does NOT ❌ violate our advertising standards for 43 of them while eleven were already removed and one is still hanging in limbo which is basically the same gaslight treatment the BBC 📺 got earlier when their report didn't trigger instant takedowns either!!

META 🧱 keeps DROPPING 📉 statements claiming they DONT ❌ TOLERATE nudify apps or any CHILD 🧒 exploitation whether REAL 🧍 or AI 🤖 generated because these CRIMINALS 🦹 keep shifting tactics to dodge detection so the company is forever strengthening its systems yet somehow these ads still SLIPPED 🧴 through with total ad spend under FIVE 💵 THOUSAND dollars and most getting fewer than TWO HUNDRED impressions before getting axed after TTP and BBC poked them which makes their built different moderation sound more like a participation trophy 🏆 while their own ad agency partners in CHINA 🇨🇳 were the ones placing a bunch of these violating promos that channel billions in Chinese cash 💰 onto the platforms!! The distribution of this material is a straight up CRIMINAL ⚖️ OFFENSE in India and META 🧱 policy flat out bans ads that sexually exploit or endanger kids but here we are with the Tech Transparency Project having reported ALL of them to NCMEC 📍 anyway while Indian cyber police officer Shikha Goel 👮‍♀️ points out how easy it is for users to hop between platforms making it harder to actually NAB 🛑 the perps and shes hoping the government will force social media intermediaries to step up in their next meetings!!

AFTER 🕒 the initial BBC 📺 investigation META 🧱 posted a whole essay on its website about how hard they fight child exploitation and how anyone can report ads that break the rules yet when TTP tested that reporting flow on the 84 Indian ads it only worked while they were live and the responses were mostly we reviewed it and its FINE ✅ which is wild because the ads were literally using manipulated photos of REAL 🧍 children to sell AI tools for creating more CSAM 📉 and even though META 🧱 eventually removed everything after being contacted the pattern shows their automated review system that checks images video text audio targeting and destination links is getting absolutely COOKED 🍳 by determined criminals who keep exploiting the ad pipeline including through those official Chinese reseller partners that never even replied to questions!! Bhuwan Ribhu keeps hammering that these companies are flouting Indian child protection laws by not reporting directly to local agencies and his Supreme Court petition is pushing for mandatory ID and reporting so the whole ecosystem stops treating this like a game of whack a mole 🦔 while the NCMEC stays the main global dump for reports even though Indian groups say its nowhere near enough to protect the kids on the ground!!
